regime_context: Canada/TSX detector shows a broad (69% eligible) precious-metals-led regime with Gold Miners (XGD.TO) the clear cross-sectional leader on trend durability (0.82, hurst 'trend', full breadth) and Silver & Royalties as the nearest challenger; Base Metals/Oil/Tech are crowded (sizing cautions only). The backtest verdict confirms the only validated edge is the absolute-trend drawdown gate, and this desk's own 54-call track record is directionally weak (dir_accuracy 0.278), so all leans default low conviction.
emerging_watch: Watching Base Metals & Copper (XBM.TO): already crowded (z 1.11) and rank 3, so not a call — but if its crowding z falls back below 0.8 while its durability bar stays above 0.7 and breadth holds 1.0 over the next two weeks, it would re-open as a metals-leadership extension candidate.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the only theme combining top cross-sectional rank, trend-health durability (0.82), a 'trend' hurst tag, and full breadth (1.0) without a crowding flag. The absolute-trend gate — the single validated risk leg — is satisfied (eligible=true), so the lean is a staying-power expression, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Precious metals leadership is reflexive in macro-narrative terms; the cross-sectional rank has no validated forward alpha, and a 0.75 crowding z (rising toward 1) means the trade is increasingly owned, so a sharp reversal in spot gold would hit this theme hardest.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO closes below its own 50-day moving average and lags the S&P/TSX by 3% within the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties is the confirmed challenger with a high durability bar (0.76) and full breadth, eligible under the trend gate. It is a precious-metals companion lean — supported only insofar as the broader metals leadership holds; no independent alpha claim.
theses.dissent: Its proxy is shared with Gold Miners (XGD.TO), so the lean adds concentration rather than diversification; hurst is only 'mixed', and silver-specific beta can decouple from gold on industrial-demand weakness.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX by 4% within 20 trading days and silversmith-equity breadth drops below 0.5

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks are eligible with a 'trend' hurst tag but show poor internal cohesion (breadth 0.286) and a modest durability bar (0.54) — leadership is narrow and fragile relative to the metals complex, so the lean is to avoid overweighting rather than a fade.
theses.dissent: Banks are a rate-sensitive value complex; if macro flips to risk-on financials leadership, the narrow breadth today could broaden quickly and this underweight would lag.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO outperforms XGD.TO by 3% within 20 trading days and Big Banks breadth expands above 0.6

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
